selection.primary_population: all naturally retrieved historical-critical records that reach an exact captured inbound request at first exposure

canonical_wire_pair.duplicate_post_check: http_upstream_request was already verified identical for 97/97 requests

validity.primary_replay_validity: captured baseline and OFF replay must agree on KEEP/DROP for the critical exact record
validity.stronger_unit_validity: same function_call_output call_id compressed output hash matches captured baseline when available
validity.reason: the claim concerns the critical compressed unit; ancillary envelope transformations need not be byte-identical

claim_boundaries: Exact string retention is not equivalent to semantic information retention.
Replay evidence is a compression-fidelity result, not by itself an end-to-end task-success result.
Only records whose OFF replay reproduces the captured baseline KEEP/DROP decision are valid counterfactual replay evidence.
No LLM or agent is invoked by this replay.
